provenance.policy: Include active Google postal-code IDs whose 2020 Census ZCTA intersects a listed county or whose GeoNames ZIP county matches it. If a ZIP spans two targeted places, choose the larger targeted place. Otherwise prefer a targeted Census place covering >=15% of ZIP land; then a targeted postal town, then the postal town. Known observed non-target cities are included only with Census or GeoNames county evidence. Other IDs use the market fallback.
provenance.limitation: A ZIP can cross town and county lines. One town per ZIP cannot identify an individual home; Census ZCTAs approximate USPS ZIP boundaries.
